plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-flash-net-mon

> The **network monitor / outbound audit** companion plugin for
> [dsh-flash](https://gitee.com/lenin.guo/dsh-flash) — it registers its own alert
> providers and its own panel switch instead of living inside dsh-flash's `apply()`.

Version 0.3.1 · Apache-2.0

**[中文](./README.zh-CN.md)**

## What it does

Two capabilities, one in each half of the plugin:

1. **Network monitor (connectivity heartbeat)** — polls `/plugins/dsh-flash/health`
   on a schedule and turns "slow" and "timed out" into dsh-flash alerts.
2. **Outbound audit (fetch tracing)** — optionally wraps the global `fetch` and
   records a **metadata-level** list of outbound requests, grades each one
   normal / suspect / dangerous by risk score, and offers filtering, whitelists and
   an explanation of the scoring.

Auditing is **off by default** (`netAuditEnabled: false`). The setting is
`volatile()` only in the Cordis sense (live-editable without remounting); once you
turn the switch on, the value is persisted through DSH's settings namespace and
survives restarts, exactly like the host whitelist.

## What it registers

### Host half — `src/index.ts` → `dist/index.js`

A Cordis plugin named `dsh-flash-net-mon`.

| Thing | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Settings namespace | `dsh-flash-net-mon` |
| Fields | `netAuditEnabled`, `netLogCap`, `netLogTtlSec`, `netSuspectWarn`, `netSuspectErr`, `netWhitelist`, `netPluginWhitelist`, `netSlowThreshold`, `netPollBase`, `netPollMin` |
| Routes | `/plugins/dsh-flash-net-mon/network-log`, `/network-alerts`, `/network-whitelist`, `/network-plugin-whitelist` |

The host half has **no host-side service dependency** (`inject: []`): everything is
injected lazily — `settings` for preferences, `webServer` for the routes.

### Browser half — `lib/client.js` (no build step)

| Registration | Through |
| --- | --- |
| Alert provider `dsh-flash-net-mon:network-alert` (heartbeat) | `ctx.get('dockFlashAlerts').registerProvider()` |
| Alert provider `dsh-flash-net-mon:network-audit` (audit alerts) | `ctx.get('dockFlashAlerts').registerProvider()` |
| Panel switch `dsh-flash-net-mon:monitor-network` | `ctx.get('quickControl').registerSwitch()` |

Switch properties: `type: 'toggle'`, `group: 'system'`, `cluster: 'system-alerts'`,
`order: 60`, `icon: 'signal'`. Its **visibility follows dsh-flash's
`dock-flash:system-alerts` master toggle** — with the alert registry switched off,
this switch has nothing to drive. Its subtitle carries the current on/off state, and
the plugin notifies the row to re-render when that state changes.

> **Dual discovery.** `ctx.get('quickControl')` / `ctx.get('dockFlashAlerts')` resolve
> asynchronously, so registration has three routes: listening for the
> `dock-flash:ready` event (for when dsh-flash loads after us), a synchronous
> `ctx.get()` check (for when it loaded before us), and a short fallback poll — up to
> 15 attempts, 200 ms apart. The first one to succeed sets `_registered`, so nothing
> registers twice.

## Using the panel and the switch

### The switch

In dsh-flash's quick panel, under **⚙️ System → System Alerts**, find **Network
Monitor**:

- the subtitle shows the live on/off state;
- turning it on writes `netAuditEnabled = true` to the host, and the host installs the
  fetch tracer;
- turning it off **restores the original `fetch`** and releases the monitor, so all
  recording stops.

**Single authority.** The host-side `netAuditEnabled` setting is the one source of
truth for whether the monitor is on. It is written through DSH's settings namespace
(the same durable mechanism that persists the host whitelist), so it survives restart
— `volatile()` here only means the field is editable at runtime without remounting, not
that DSH forgets it. The switch reads that persisted value and writes back through the
settings bridge; there is no separate localStorage copy to reconcile, so the toggle is
exactly where you left it after a restart and can never silently fork from the host.

### The config modal

The **Configure** button beside the switch opens the network monitor config modal:

| Control | Range | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Slow threshold `netSlowThreshold` | 1000–15000 ms, step 500 | 5000 ms |
| Poll base interval `netPollBase` | 10000–120000 ms, step 5000 | 60000 ms |
| Poll minimum interval `netPollMin` | 5000–30000 ms, step 1000 | 10000 ms |
| Log capacity `netLogCap` | 50–1000 entries, step 50 | 300 |
| Retention `netLogTtlSec` | 0–120 min, step 5 (0 = keep forever) | 60 min |
| Suspect threshold `netSuspectWarn` | 10–90, step 5 | 40 |
| Danger threshold `netSuspectErr` | 20–100, step 5 | 70 |

Below those, two more blocks: a foldable **risk scoring algorithm** explanation, and
the embedded **network audit** panel.

### The network audit panel

All three sub-tabs share one data source: the panel fetches `GET /network-log` every
`max(netPollMin, netPollBase)` (60 s by default) **without `limit`**, so it takes the
server's default of 100 entries, newest first — after that, every filter and page turn
happens in the browser.

- **Requests** — 10 rows per page, with page info and previous/next at the bottom.
  Columns: method, host, path, status (2xx green / 4xx yellow / 5xx red), risk,
  duration; time, request/response sizes, TLS, plugin and flags live in the
  **details** block that expands **inline** when a row is clicked (click the same row
  again or press Escape to collapse it; the rest of the modal stays visible).
- **Alerts** — the rows of that same data whose risk is ≥ `netSuspectWarn`, coloured by
  risk (≥ `netSuspectErr` takes the danger colour). This tab is **not** a second data
  stream.
- **Whitelist** — switch between the host and plugin views, remove entries with ✕. The
  host view also has "common services (one click)" chips and a **read-only**
  "auto-trusted" row; the plugin view lists the plugins seen in the log (click Trust to
  add one) plus a manual input. The details block still offers "add host to whitelist" /
  "add plugin to whitelist".

Toolbar: sub-tab switch, plugin filter (options come from the currently loaded
entries), risk filter (normal / suspect / dangerous), **pause / resume** (stops polling
while the backend keeps recording, so resuming shows what accumulated), and **clear**
(`DELETE /network-log`, which clears the backend ring buffer and scoring state rather
than just the screen — afterwards both Requests and Alerts are empty). Auto-scroll is
internal: while not paused and auto-scroll is on, the list follows the newest page.

**Alert notifications take a different route.** The
`dsh-flash-net-mon:network-audit` provider polls `GET /network-alerts` (at the same
`max(netPollMin, netPollBase)` cadence) and pushes newly seen high-risk requests into
dsh-flash's alert registry. It de-duplicates by `seq`, so the same request never
raises twice, and it skips anything matched by the host or plugin whitelist.

Whitelist writes go two ways: effective in memory immediately, and persisted through
`ctx.remote.settings` into the `dsh-flash-net-mon` namespace. The client and the two
`network-*-whitelist` routes use that same setting, so whichever writes second wins; if
the settings service is unavailable, the in-memory override still applies.

"Common services (one click)" offers 15 known API hosts (exact host names such as
`api.openai.com` or `dashscope.aliyuncs.com`); one click adds that host to the user's
whitelist. Anything already covered is greyed out and tagged with where the coverage
comes from ("added", "built-in", or "configured endpoint"). The list deliberately
contains **no host that serves user content** (`github.io`, `raw.githubusercontent.com`,
`*.s3.amazonaws.com`, `*.cloudfront.net`, …) — trusting one of those would open the audit
to every third-party payload fetched through it. It is a set of buttons, never an
automatic write.

## Risk scoring

Every outbound request scores 0–100:

| Factor | Adds |
| --- | --- |
| Unknown host: not on the built-in trusted list / user host whitelist, and not from a trusted plugin (baseline) | +30 |
| First time this host is seen (`new-host`) | +15 |
| Large upload: `POST`/`PUT`/`PATCH` with a body over 1 KB (`lar

plugins.description: Self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness: bounded self-managed memory, an automatic per-turn review that refines skills instead of duplicating them, a skill health check, cross-session recall, and a learning card that appears only when it has something to say.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-self-evolution

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4B6BFB.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-host%20%2B%20client%20regression-2E9E5B.svg)](#tests)

> An agent that forgets everything it worked out is expensive to work with. This plugin is the memory.

A self-evolution layer for **[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)** — bounded long-term memory, an automatic review that runs after every turn, procedural memory that refines skills instead of piling them up, a health check for skills the loader would silently drop, cross-session recall, a **durable row inside the conversation** that says what it just learned, and a card above the composer that is reserved for changes waiting on your decision.

It is a port of the self-improvement loop from [Nous Research's Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) onto DSH's own primitives (`ctx.tools` + `ctx.systemPrompt`). **The DSH core is not patched.** The memory file format is byte-compatible with Hermes, so the two are interchangeable.

![Just learned](screenshots/02-just-learned.png)

---

## Why this exists

Out of the box, DSH starts every session from zero. Whatever it worked out with you yesterday — the build command, the deploy quirk, the thing you corrected it on — is gone.

Hermes solves this with a background self-improvement review and two bounded memory files. DSH has the primitives to do the same but no implementation. This plugin is that implementation, plus the parts that make automatic learning **safe to leave switched on**:

- **It cannot lose what it learned by writing badly.** Every write is re-read and re-linted; a skill that would be dropped by the loader is rolled back, never reported as saved.
- **It cannot quietly rewrite your memory.** The unattended review can only *add*. Deleting or rewording asks first, shows you the exact text it would destroy, and pins that text so the approval can never land on a different entry.
- **It cannot become invisible furniture.** Everything below the fold is optional; the only thing it insists on is being readable at the moment it has news.

---

## Features

### 1. Bounded, self-managed memory

| | |
|---|---|
| **Store** | `<dshHome>/self-evolution/MEMORY.md` (agent notes) and `USER.md` (about you), entries separated by `§` — the same format as Hermes, so files are interchangeable |
| **Actions** | `add` / `replace` / `remove` / `list`; replace and remove locate an entry by a **unique substring** and refuse when the match is ambiguous |
| **Limits** | 2200 / 1375 characters by default (same as Hermes); **no automatic compaction** — when full, the tool returns `ok:false` *with every current entry*, so the model consolidates in the same turn and retries |
| **Deduplication** | An exact duplicate is rejected ("No duplicate added") |
| **Safety scan** | Before anything becomes durable: invisible Unicode (zero-width / bidirectional controls), instruction-override attempts, system-prompt exfiltration, private keys and cloud credentials, `authorized_keys` persistence, `curl … \| sh`. A hit is refused (`scanOnWrite: false` to disable) |
| **Injection** | A system-prompt section `self-evolution:memory` (order 100, `interpolate: false` — **memory text is never parsed as a `{{template}}`**), headed by `[67% — 1474/2200 chars]` |

### 2. `skill_learn` — the write side of procedural memory

Turns a workflow you just worked out into a `SKILL.md` under a skill root DSH actually scans (default `<projectRoot>/.dsh/skills` — inside the workspace, no approval and no restart needed).

The point of this tool is that **a skill it writes can always be loaded**:

- frontmatter values are emitted as JSON double-quoted scalars, which removes whole classes of "unquoted `description` containing `": "` → YAML parse failure → skill silently discarded" accidents;
- the file is **re-read and re-linted immediately after writing**, and rolled back (created → deleted, rewritten → restored) if it would not load — it never reports a skill it cannot prove is loadable;
- a `description` over 500 characters is rejected outright, because the catalog truncates silently past that point.

### 3. `skill_doctor` — the curator

DSH **silently discards** any skill whose frontmatter fails to parse, with no warning anywhere. `skill_doctor` scans every skill root DSH reads, reports which skills would be dropped and why, and keeps *load errors* (the skill disappears) separate from *quality warnings* (the skill loads but gets truncated):

- **load errors** — no frontmatter, missing `name`/`description`, non-kebab-case name, an unquoted value containing `": "` or ending in `:`, an unterminated quote, a duplicate key, a tab inside frontmatter;
- **quality warnings** — `description` over 500 characters.

With `fix: true` it repairs **surgically**: it rewrites only the offending line (adding quotes) and leaves every other byte — other frontmatter keys and the whole body — untouched, after backing the file up to `<file>.bak-<timestamp>`. It re-checks afterwards and gives up rather than claim a fix it cannot verify.

### 4. The automatic review — it learns after every turn

Everything above only happens if the model *remembers to do it*. This feature makes it automatic: when a turn ends, the plugin calls a **cheap auxiliary model** (no tools, JSON out) to decide whether the turn contained anything worth keeping, and writes it if so.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Trigger** | listens for the session's `turn/end` |
| **Skips** | turns that ended interrupted or in error **never learn**; turns with fewer than `reviewMinSteps` (2) tool steps are treated as trivial; only one review runs at a time |
| **Input** | the last `reviewMaxEvents` (40) events of the turn as compact text, capped at `reviewMaxChars` (6000); the text extraction follows the official one (reasoning blocks dropped, tool calls and results kept, errors marked) |
| **Output contract** | strict JSON — `{"memory":[{target,content}],"skill":{name,description,body}|null,"reason":"…"}`; the prompt asks explicitly for **restraint** (0–2 entries is normal, an empty result is a valid answer) |
| **Landing** | goes through **the same write path as the tools** — same scan, same limits, same dedupe, same read-back check — so the two can never drift apart |
| **Model** | defaults to whatever model the session is using; `reviewProvider`/`reviewModel` override it |
| **Failure** | **every failure is swallowed**: model down, timeout, garbage response, refused write — none of it can affect your session |
| **Skills** | **creates and refines**: a second pass merges new knowledge into an existing skill and compresses the result, instead of growing thirty near-duplicate skills |

### 5. Skills do not pile up

Hermes improves existing skills, which is why a month of similar tasks leaves one skill rather than thirty. Both paths exist here:

| Review verdict | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `"action":"create"` | a genuinely new workflow → new skill |
| `"action":"improve"` | an existing skill already covers this → **a second model call** (that skill's current body plus the new knowledge) merges them into one deduplicated, compressed body, then replaces the file wholesale |

Four guardrails: the prompt carries the **existing skill catalog** (name + truncated description, 40 by default) so the model can recognise "this is the same kind of thing"; the file is **backed up** to `<file>.bak-<timestamp>` before every rewrite; a merged body over `skillMaxChars` (12000) is rejected and the old version kept, so skills cannot grow without bound; and the result is re-read and re-linted, rolling back if it would not load. `reviewSkillUpdates: false` turns rewriting off entirely and leaves creation only.

### 6. `session_search` — recall across sessions

Searches the **actual messages** of every past session. Memory is what the agent chose to keep; this searches everything that was ever said.

| Mode | What it does |
|---|---|
| `search` | full-text search acro

plugins.description: Nexus spec-driven development agent preset for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# Nexus SDLC · Nexus 规范研发

A declarative DeepSeek Harness agent preset for spec-driven development: Claude Code planning/review/distillation and Codex implementation/testing, coordinated through a Chinese persona and four static delegation tools. No custom Host code or browser UI is shipped.

包名 `dsh-plugin-nexus-sdlc`、Preset ID `nexus-sdlc` 均不包含 DSH 版本号。兼容版本只在 [package.json](package.json) 的 `peerDependencies` 中声明。

## Compatibility / 兼容性

- Currently checked against DSH core **0.2.0-rc.2**. Desktop shell versions are not DSH core versions. Other core releases are intentionally not claimed compatible.
- Intended for a base-backed Web/Desktop Profile with the official filesystem, subprocess, job, command, agent and preset services. Shell tooling currently targets macOS/Linux; Windows is unverified.
- The two official provider packages must already be installed in the target Profile, with working native Claude Code/Codex configuration and authentication.
- DSH peers are marked optional for npm resolution **only** to avoid auto-installing a second harness/runtime. They remain required capabilities for this composition; DSH still checks their declared versions.
- Taskboard guidance applies when `dsh-taskboard` is available; this package neither installs the board nor enables its auto-sync or changes its settings. Without a board, report its absence and do not fabricate task operations.

## Install / 安装

Replace `desktop` with your own Profile. In Desktop, use its plugin manager if the CLI is not on PATH. Install missing prerequisites first:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex@0.2.0-rc.2
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code@0.2.0-rc.2
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-nexus-sdlc
```

Refresh/restart as your client requires, then select **Nexus 规范研发** (`nexus-sdlc`) for a new conversation. Installation does not change your default preset.

已有本地旧版 `nexus-sdlc-0-1-7-rc-2` 可以继续保留；本公开包使用新的稳定 ID 和独立 Provider 名，不覆盖旧版或 PTC。旧会话不会自动迁移；新会话请选新版，确认后再按需卸载旧版。不要同时重复安装本包的本地副本和 npm 副本。

## Workflow and tools / 工作流与工具

1. Clarify a Spec and testable acceptance criteria.
2. `subagent_claude_plan`: Claude Code planning.
3. `subagent_codex_dev`: implementation, tests and targeted fixes.
4. `subagent_claude_review`: evidence-based review, then re-review if needed.
5. `subagent_claude_distill`: durable knowledge only after review and user acceptance.

The main session also has shell/filesystem/search/job tools, `/goal`, goal tools and the official isolated planning controller. `/feedback` belongs to the Host rather than being duplicated by this bundle.

**This is prompt-guided coordination, not an automatic FSM.** It does not provide a live execution dashboard, guarantee that reviewers cannot write, or guarantee a successful external model call. It does not make review statements substitutes for actual test evidence. Delegation occurs only when the user authorizes it. If a required provider is unavailable, report the failure instead of claiming a role ran.

## Provider configuration and safety

Dedicated provider rows are `nexus-sdlc-provider-codex` and `nexus-sdlc-provider-claude-code`, registered as `nexus-sdlc-codex` and `nexus-sdlc-claude-code`. Codex uses `permissionMode: never`; Claude uses `permissionMode: plan`. These preserve the local preset safety baseline and do not bypass approvals or sandboxing. Native restrictions can still block implementation or distillation.

No personal paths, gateways, model aliases, credentials or CLI state are shipped. `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` is the only explicit environment value, for Electron-based launchers; it is not a credential. Model/authentication choices remain in your native configuration or explicit Profile overrides. Credential-like environment variables may be scrubbed by official providers; if your backend requires an explicit `env` overlay, configure it privately. Never commit secrets or put them in the public package.

需要自定义时，只覆盖上述独立 Provider 行的 `config.model`/`config.env` 等受支持字段；不要改共享的 `codex`/`claude-code` Provider，也不要无意修改其他会话的权限。安装 Profile 插件会影响同 Profile 的会话，建议先在隔离 Profile 验证。

## Verification / 验证

```sh
npm ci
npm test
# Optional: inspect actual installed DSH schemas and compatibility gate
DSH_APP_DIR="/path/to/dsh/installation" DSH_PROFILE_DIR="/path/to/profile" npm run test:host
npm pack --dry-run
```

Unit tests cover stable identity, absence of personal data, role binding, permission defaults, peer version boundaries and file scope. The host checker uses actual installed schemas and official compatibility matching; it makes no model calls and does not alter the Profile. Full external-provider execution and GUI behavior are not implied by schema checks. See [verification notes](https://github.com/Fnckerpoi/dsh-plugin-nexus-sdlc/blob/main/docs/verification.md).

## License / 许可

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Independently authored configuration, not an official DeepSeek product.

# 璺道的 DSH 插件仓库

基于deepseek harness自我生产的插件。

## dsh-plugin-matt-skills

把 [Matt Pocock 的 Skills For Real Engineers](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) 的 27 个工程 skill 装进每个 DeepSeek Harness 会话：11 个由模型按任务自动取用，16 个由你在输入框用 `/` 唤起。全部按需加载，不调用就不占上下文。

安装（把 `desktop` 换成你的 profile 名）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-matt-skills
```

卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-matt-skills
```

插件本体在 [`dsh-plugin-matt-skills/`](./dsh-plugin-matt-skills/)，完整说明见它的 [README](./dsh-plugin-matt-skills/README.md)。

## dsh-plugin-diagram-design

把 [Cathryn Lavery 的 Diagram Design](https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design) 装进每个 DeepSeek Harness 会话：**42 种编辑风图表**，输出自包含 HTML + SVG，并且能把已有的 draw.io、Mermaid、Excalidraw 图**重画**进同一套设计系统（是重画，不是渲染）。模型按任务自动取用，不调用就不占上下文。

安装（把 `desktop` 换成你的 profile 名）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-diagram-design
```

卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-diagram-design
```

运行前提：出图走它自带的 Python 工具，需要 **Python 3**；要导出 PNG 另需 `pip install playwright && playwright install chromium`。只出 HTML / SVG 则不需要。

插件本体在 [`dsh-plugin-diagram-design/`](./dsh-plugin-diagram-design/)，完整说明见它的 [README](./dsh-plugin-diagram-design/README.md)。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：将系统提示词本地化为简体中文，并按会话当前可见工具裁剪相关指引；保留英文工具 schema。
plugins.readme_text:
# Prompt ZH **少一点语言切换，多一点规则可读性。** DeepSeek Harness 的系统提示词中文化插件。把已知英文规则译成简体中文，并加入中文语言指令，引导 Deepseek 使用中文回复；不改宿主源码，不改工具名和参数结构。 中文提示词是语言引导，不是输出保证。其他模型不一定同样遵循；本轮未做跨模型回复语言对照测试。 [![Release](https://github.com/KouzakiUmi/dsh-prompt-zh/actions/workflows/release.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/KouzakiUmi/dsh-prompt-zh/actions/workflows/release.yml) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-prompt-zh?color=1f6feb&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-prompt-zh) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-68786a)](LICENSE) [开始使用](#开始使用) · [覆盖范围](#中文化不等于全部改写) · [兼容性](docs/compatibility.md) · [开发文档](docs/development.md) · [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)
## 规则更易读，契约不改动 它不是聊天翻译器。Prompt ZH 在宿主的提示词组装和运行时注入环节处理已知规则，并提供原生译文设置页：逐条编辑实际替换用的译文、按组件开关、查看精确版本与插件阶段的命中／输出改变信号。 | 你关心的内容 | Prompt ZH 如何处理 | | --- | --- | | 系统行为指引 | 中文化已知提示词段落，按当前可见工具裁剪相关句子 | | MCP 使用规则 | Blender、Context7、GitHub、Playwright、Chrome DevTools 按已知原文守卫翻译，不依赖服务器版本；未知服务器保持原文，不用 MCP 客户端版本冒充 | | 运行时提醒 | 处理时间／时区、工作区指令包装、技能目录调用纪律、Hindsight 记忆规则等已知文本 | | Git Bash 附加指导 | 中文化已知 MSYS 路径、shell 路由及 `run_code` 开启／关闭提示；只替换匹配的 Bash description 附加文本 | | 工具调用契约 | 保留工具名、参数 schema、代码和动态值；通用 description 及未知附加内容保持原文 | ### 看一个真实例子 ```text You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness. ↓ 你是由 DeepSeek Harness 驱动的 AI agent。 ``` ```text Browser time zone for this request: unavailable. Ask the user to clarify otherwise-unqualified dates and times. ↓ 本次请求的浏览器时区：不可用。请用户澄清未明确限定时区的日期和时间。 ``` 示例与横幅取自当前翻译函数，并有离线断言；横幅是说明图，不是 DSH 界面截图。 ## 中文化，不等于全部改写 **已知规则才替换，未知内容不猜译。** 翻译可以重复执行；没有命中时保留原文。工具相关句子按可见工具集裁剪，不向模型推荐不存在的工具。 运行时翻译保留全局兜底，并在 agent 初始化完成后注册本 agent 的作用域监听器，覆盖随后由 preset 挂载的时间等注入；对已经存在的 agent 回补，并随 agent、依赖或插件卸载清理。 1.3.2 延续逐条译文设置页，并适配已核验的 Core 0.2.1-rc.2、Git Bash 0.42.2 与 Hindsight 0.8.2；版本发布状态以 GitHub Release 与 npm registry 为准，安装后仍需在目标 Profile 验收。Git Bash、Hindsight 仅在当前解析包版本与条目已核验精确版本一致时翻译，未知或不符版本保留原文；已知 MCP server 独立按原文守卫执行。Git Bash context 在组装时可以有译文，但当前 Core 的后续 `refreshContext` 仍可能恢复来源英文；补译文不等于改变宿主的最终快照生成。 ## 逐条编辑译文 在宿主的 **Prompt ZH 设置页**或插件配置区域中，每条内置译文都有区块、匹配方式、已核验／当前解析版本和处理计数。编辑框默认是内置译文，保存覆盖值后由实际翻译函数读取；不能编辑原文匹配规则。 - **保存到当前 Profile**：使用原生配置表单及修订号校验，不使用浏览器存储代替。保存成功不代表已经遇到原文或最终请求已生效。 - **还原全部草稿／还原此条草稿**：只改变编辑内容，再点保存才持久化。 - **组件开关**：关闭后对应文本保留原文；第三方版本门控不能由开关绕过（MCP 已知 server 例外：按每条原文守卫执行，不依赖服务器版本，未知 server 仍不翻译）。 - **刷新信号**：读取当前保存配置的累计命中／输出改变；不保留会话正文或动态捕获值。 - **工具可见性保护**：关联工具缺失时，该段自定义译文临时回退内置值再裁剪，并显示回退次数；保存值不变，关联工具齐全时继续使用自定义译文。 动态 `$1`、`$2` 等占位符必须保留。保存失败或并发冲突保留草稿，不会自动覆盖更新后的远端配置。详见[设置说明]()。 > [!IMPORTANT] > **仍看到英文，不一定是插件未生效。** 宿主在翻译之后重建的 runtime-context 快照、创建完成后新增的外层注入方，以及宿主之外追加的系统消息仍可能为英文。技能自身的摘要／正文、未知 MCP 正文和工具 schema 也不做全面翻译。完整边界见 [兼容性与覆盖范围](docs/compatibility.md)。 ## 开始使用 ### 安装 npm 版本 一般安装参考使用 `dsh plugin`，以下统一以 `web` 作为示例 Profile： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-prompt-zh ``` 更新已安装版本： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-prompt-zh@latest ``` `web` 仅是文档示例，不代表你的实际安装目标。实际操作前应核实环境、Profile 和命令入口；Desktop 使用目标桌面壳自带的 DSH Desktop CLI，不用独立公共/Core CLI 管理保留的 `desktop` Profile，也不在 Profile 中裸跑 npm/pnpm 安装。 安装／更新后，按部署方式重新启动或重载 DSH，让 Host 插件重新加载。**npm 徽章显示实际已发布版本；main、版本字段与当前运行会话不自动等同。** ### 使用固定版本的 Release 包 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/KouzakiUmi/dsh-prompt-zh/releases) 下载 `dsh-prompt-zh.tgz`，使用下载文件的绝对路径： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile web add "" ``` 不要把 GitHub 源码 ZIP 当作验证过的发布包。已有安装优先用上面的 npm 更新命令。 ## 克制，也包括权限 **不读取账户凭据，不改宿主安装包，不启动子进程，不向外部翻译服务发送提示词。** 翻译处理本身不写文件；保存操作复用宿主原生配置表单，由宿主写入当前 Profile。版本证据只读取公开解析得到的包 manifest 名称／版本；客户端仅以同源 GET 读取已认证的固定诊断路径，不进行外部网络翻译。 - `systemPrompt` 是必需宿主服务；`agents` 动态接入，缺少时保留静态翻译与全局兜底。 - Node.js 要求 `>=18`；DSH 范围仅列已核验的 Core `0.2.1-alpha.2`、`0.2.1-alpha.3`、`0.2.1-rc.2`，范围与逐版本声明保持一致。兼容声明不代表所有宿主、provider 和插件组合均完成现场验收。 - 当前适配基线为 Desktop 壳 `2.0.19-next` 随包 Core `0.2.1-rc.2`、Cordis `4.0.5` 与 Schemastery `3.18.5`；宿主隔离测试及真实 React 离线浏览器回归均通过。保留 alpha.3 fixture 回归；没有在生产 Profile 安装或进行真实配置保存验收。 ## 进一步了解 | 文档 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | [兼容性与覆盖范围](docs/compatibility.md) | 能翻译什么、英文残留原因、已验证环境与权限边界 | | [开发与验证](docs/development.md) | 模块结构、离线测试、真实宿主验证、打包与发布流程 | | [本轮适配与加固报告](docs/audit-report.md) | 本轮改动、真实会话巡检结果、验证证据与待决事项 | | [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md) | 1.2.6 的修复内容与已核实的历史里程碑 | | [展示资源说明](assets/README.md) | 横幅的事实来源、字体引用与文档素材约定 | --- [MIT License](LICENSE) · [报告问题](https://github.com/KouzakiUmi/dsh-prompt-zh/issues) · [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/KouzakiUmi/dsh-prompt-zh/releases)

plugins.description: DSH 错误分类修正插件：把适配器一律判成 AUTH 的提供方失败改写为 PROVIDER_ERROR，让网关原文原样显示，而不是被 UI 替换成「API 密钥无效」。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-llm-error-classify

[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-1f6feb.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-DSH%20Web-4c8bf5.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

**DSH 错误分类修正插件** —— 让提供方的原始报错**原样显示**，不再被 UI 替换成一句固定的「API 密钥无效」。

网关说「当前分组下没有可用渠道」，你看到的却是「API 密钥无效」，然后跑去换一个根本没问题的密钥。本插件修掉这个误导。

## 安装

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lxl8182/dsh-llm-error-classify

# 或从本地目录安装
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-llm-error-classify
```

然后**重启 dsh web**。零依赖、零构建：纯 JavaScript，无 `prepare` 脚本，不需要单独跑 `npm install`。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-llm-error-classify
```

升级 `github:` 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-llm-error-classify`，再重启 dsh web。

## 解决什么问题

pi-ai 适配器只凭**文本**给失败分类（`llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts` 的 `classifyPiAiError`），而它的第一条规则是：

```ts
if (/\b(?:401|403)\b/.test(message)) return 'AUTH'
```

这条规则排在所有更具体的判断**之前**，所以任何 401/403 都变成 `AUTH`——余额耗尽、渠道被禁用、令牌无权使用该模型、IP 未白名单、以及真正的密钥错误，到达 UI 时长得一模一样。

而 `AUTH` 恰好是 UI **唯一拒绝原样渲染**的 code：

| 位置 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `ui-chat/.../conversation-nodes/event-projection.ts` | `if (code === 'AUTH') return { code, message: '' }` — **清空正文** |
| `ui-trajectory/.../trajectory-event-projection.ts` | 同上，第二处 UI 表面 |
| `ui-chat/.../chat/MessageItem.tsx` | `code === 'AUTH'` → 替换为 `message.failure.auth`，即「API 密钥无效」 |
| `ui-trajectory/.../TrajectoryTable.tsx` | `errorCode === 'AUTH'` → 替换为 `details.failure.auth` |

## 它怎么修

挂到 `llm/stream` waterfall（`packages/llm/llm/src/index.ts`）。它包裹适配器原始的 chunk 迭代器，因此能在 agent loop 落盘之前看到终态 `finish` chunk，改写其中的 failure code。改在这里同时修正**持久化会话记录**和 **UI 渲染**。

规则只有一条：**凡 `code === 'AUTH'` 的终态失败，改写成 `PROVIDER_ERROR`，并保留原始文本。**

`PROVIDER_ERROR` 是刻意选的，两个集合都不在里面：

- **不在 UI 特判集合里**（特判集合为 `AUTH`、`QUOTA`、`ACCOUNT_QUOTA`、`ACCOUNT_SIGNED_OUT`、`ACCOUNT_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED`）。UI 的渲染函数对其它一切 code 都直接回落到 `message`／`error`，所以提供方原文原样显示。
- **不在默认可重试集合里**（`retry-policy.ts`：只有 `EMPTY_RESPONSE`、`RATE_LIMIT`、`SERVER`、`TIMEOUT`、`TRANSPORT`）。行为与原先的 `AUTH` 完全一致，不会因此多出重试。

效果对照（`displayFailure` 实测输出）：

```
AUTH           -> {"code":"AUTH","message":""}                      ← 正文被清空
PROVIDER_ERROR -> {"code":"PROVIDER_ERROR","message":"当前分组下没有可用渠道"}
```

不再需要维护任何配额词表：不管网关报的是欠费、渠道还是权限，原文都会显示。这也顺带修掉了原版只认配额措辞、其余网关 403 仍误报密钥无效的盲区。

## 为什么要清洗密钥

上游清空 `AUTH` 正文是**双重目的**的（见 `event-projection.ts` 的注释）：

> Provider AUTH messages may echo a masked or partially preserved credential.
> Keep the raw diagnostic in the Session log, but never retain it in UI state.

它既是为了显示得好看，也是一道**凭证防泄漏**。改写 code 会让原文进入 UI 状态，等于拆掉这道防护，所以插件在放行前先清洗凭证形状的子串（替换为 `[redacted]`）：

- 厂商前缀密钥：`sk-…`、`sk-proj-…`、`ghp_…`、`github_pat_…`、`xoxb-…` 等；
- 消息里回显的 `Bearer <token>`。

**这里是按形状匹配，不是按值匹配**：`GenerateOptions` 不携带凭证（适配器私下解析），插件拿不到真实密钥，因此一个没有任何厂商前缀特征的裸密钥无法被识别。这是本方案已知的残留缺口——若你所用网关会回显此类密钥，请勿依赖本插件的清洗。

## 已知限制

- **不改重试行为**，也不改任何非 `AUTH` 的 code。它只做一件事：`AUTH → PROVIDER_ERROR` 加凭证清洗。
- **凭证清洗按形状匹配**（见上），无厂商前缀的裸密钥识别不了。
- 依赖宿主内部的 code 语义（UI 特判集合、默认可重试集合）。DSH 升级若改动这两个集合，需要跟着调整 `PROVIDER_ERROR_CODE` 的选择。

## 验证

以下命令在**仓库副本**里运行（`dsh plugin add` 装进 profile 的副本只包含运行时文件 `index.js`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`README.md`）。

逻辑层：

```sh
node test.mjs
```

- 正向：网关配额 403、无可用渠道 403、令牌无权 403、真密钥 401 —— 全部 `AUTH → PROVIDER_ERROR`；
- 反向：非 `AUTH` 的 code（`RATE_LIMIT`/`QUOTA`/`SERVER`）原样不动；
- 文本保留：渠道报错原文完整可见；
- 凭证清洗：回显的 `sk-proj-…` 与 `Bearer …` 均被抹掉；
- 结构：非 finish chunk 原样返回、`aborted` 终态同样修正。

端到端（经真实 `llm/stream` waterfall）：

```sh
DSH_REPO=/path/to/dsh-checkout node probe-e2e.mjs
```

探针插件注册一个抛出 `new LlmError(403 网关文本, 'AUTH')` 的适配器，跑 `ctx.llm.stream()`，确认终态 finish chunk 的 code 变成 `PROVIDER_ERROR`、文本保留且密钥已被抹掉。探针通过 `createRequire` 从 dsh 安装目录解析宿主包（`DSH_REPO` 指定该目录，默认为当前目录）。

## 结构

```
index.js          宿主半边：llm/stream waterfall 监听，改写终态 failure
cordis.patch.yml  bundle 层，插入宿主行 llm-error-classify
test.mjs          逻辑层检查
probe-e2e.mjs     端到端探针（需 dsh checkout）
```

## 上游修复建议

根因在宿主，本插件是绕开而非根治。彻底修法是三处小改：

1. `llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts`：把 `isQuotaExceededError` 等更具体的判断提到 401/403 分支**之前**，并且不要仅凭「文本里有 403」就判定为认证失败；
2. `llm/src/error.ts` 的 `isQuotaExceededError`：补下划线变体（`insufficient[\s_-]+(?:user[\s_-]+)?quota`）及中文额度措辞；
3. `ui-chat` / `ui-trajectory` 的 `displayFailure`：清空正文应针对「确实回显了凭证」的情况，而不是整个 `AUTH` code——否则真实认证失败之外的一切 401/403 都会被这句固定文案盖掉。

上游修好后本插件可直接卸载。

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: Translation plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Adds a two-pane Translate page to the sidebar with model, reasoning effort and prompt controls.
plugins.readme_text:
# 🌐 dsh-translate-tab **A translation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.** [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-translate-tab?color=4d6bfe)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-translate-tab) [![MIT License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek_Harness-plugin-4d6bfe)](#-installation) [![15 languages](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-15-orange)](#languages) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.9-3178c6)](#-architecture) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/zhen-bo/dsh-translate-tab) [Installation](#-installation) · [Quick start](#-quick-start) · [Usage](#-usage) · [Troubleshooting](#-troubleshooting) English | [繁體中文](docs/README.zh-TW.md)
![The Translate page in DeepSeek Harness. English source text on the left, detected automatically and translated into Traditional Chinese on the right.](docs/screenshot-dark.png) ## ✨ Features - **Sidebar integration:** adds a Translate entry under Plugins that opens a two-pane translation view in the main area. - **Shared model catalog:** uses the same providers and models as Harness chat, with adjustable reasoning effort. - **Low-latency default:** uses the catalog's default model with reasoning effort off. - **15 languages:** with automatic source language detection. - **Configurable prompt:** supports `{{target_language}}`, `{{source_language}}` and `{{text}}` variables. - **Localized interface:** follows the Harness language setting in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. ## 📋 Requirements - DeepSeek Harness desktop app with the `dsh` CLI on `PATH` - At least one model configured with a valid API key in Settings › Models ## 📦 Installation ### From DSH Plugin Hub 1. Install DSH Plugin Hub: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin ``` 2. Restart DeepSeek Harness. 3. Open **Settings › Plugin Market**, search for `dsh-translate-tab` and select **Install**. ### From npm 1. Install the plugin from the npm registry: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-translate-tab ``` 2. Restart DeepSeek Harness. ### From GitHub 1. Install the plugin from the repository: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:Zhen-Bo/dsh-translate-tab" ``` 2. Restart DeepSeek Harness. ## 🚀 Quick start 1. Open **Plugins › Translate** in the sidebar. 2. Enter the source text in the left pane. 3. Press Ctrl + Enter, or ⌘ + Enter on macOS. The translation streams into the right pane. ## 🧭 Usage ### Languages Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian and Arabic, each available as source or target. Automatic detection applies to the source and recognizes Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Thai, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English. ### Model and reasoning effort The model picker is at the top right. Reasoning effort is set with the slider below the model list. ### Translation prompt The prompt editor opens from the button next to the model picker. The prompt is sent as the user message with the following variables substituted: | Variable | Value | |---|---| | `{{target_language}}` | Target language name in English, for example `Japanese` | | `{{source_language}}` | Source language name, or `the detected source language` | | `{{text}}` | Source text. Appended to the end when the prompt omits this variable | ### Storage | Data | Location | Lifetime | |---|---|---| | Languages, model, reasoning effort and custom prompt | `localStorage` key `dsh-translate-tab:v1` | Persistent | | Source text draft | `sessionStorage` key `dsh-translate-tab:draft` | Current window session | ## 🔧 Troubleshooting | Message | Resolution | |---|---| | This model has no API key yet | Add a key in Settings › Models, or select another model | | The API key was rejected | Verify the key in Settings › Models | | Too many requests | Retry after a short wait | | The response stopped early | Run the translation again | | Text is too long | Split the source text into segments under 100,000 characters | If Translate is missing under Plugins, verify the install path and restart DeepSeek Harness. ## 🧹 Uninstall ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-translate-tab ``` Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards. ## 🧩 Architecture | Path | Runtime | Role | |---|---|---| | `src/client` | Harness window | Translate page in React and TypeScript | | `src/server` | Harness host | `POST /translate/api/stream`, streams a single model call | | `src/shared` | Both | Route, text limits and stream event types | | `locale` | Harness window | Interface text, registered with the Harness locale service | | `lib` | Both | Build output loaded by Harness |
Stream format
The route accepts same-origin requests from the Harness window and responds with newline-delimited JSON: ```text {"t":"text","v":"..."} translated text {"t":"done"} finished {"t":"aborted"} cancelled {"t":"error","message":"..."} failed ```
## 💻 Development 1. Install dependencies and link the working copy to the desktop profile: ```bash npm install dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:D:/path/to/dsh-translate-tab" ``` 2. Run the build in watch mode, then restart DeepSeek Harness to load changes: ```bash npm run dev ``` | Command | Purpose | |---|---| | `npm run build` | Builds `lib/client.js` and `lib/index.js` | | `npm run check` | Runs the type check, lint, tests and build | | `npm run fix` | Formats the code with gts | ## 📄 License Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

plugins.description: n8n workflow automation tools for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tool-n8n

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

n8n workflow automation integration for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) as a Cordis plugin. The agent can inspect workflows, version history, tags, and execution status, and explicitly activate or deactivate one workflow at a time.

## Install

```sh
npm install @libai168/dsh-tool-n8n
```

Requires `@deepseek-ai/cordis` (^4.0.1) and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (^0.1.0-rc.6) as peer dependencies.

## Configuration

```yaml
- name: 'github:LJH-snow/dsh-tool-n8n'
  config:
    baseUrl: 'https://n8n.example.com'
    apiKeyEnv: 'N8N_API_KEY'
    # timeoutMs: 15000
```

The plugin reads the n8n public API key from the environment variable named by `apiKeyEnv` (default: `N8N_API_KEY`). Do not put a usable key in source, examples, tests, or committed configuration. Create the key in n8n under **Settings > n8n API** and grant only the permissions required by the deployment.

`baseUrl` defaults to the local instance at `http://localhost:5678`. The endpoint is checked before every request. Link-local addresses (`169.254.0.0/16`, `fe80::/10`, including their IPv4-compatible, IPv4-mapped, and NAT64 forms) and the unspecified address (`0.0.0.0/8`, `::`) are always rejected: they are never a valid n8n address, and they include the cloud metadata address. Self-hosted instances stay usable by default, including loopback and private networks. Set `enforcePublicEndpoint: true` to additionally require a publicly reachable host; that mode also resolves ordinary hostnames and rejects loopback, private, CGNAT, multicast, reserved, and every IANA special-purpose range.

## Tools

| Tool | Description | Write |
|---|---|---|
| `n8n_auth_test` | Verify the API key without returning it | No |
| `n8n_list_workflows` | List workflows with cursor, active, and name filters | No |
| `n8n_get_workflow` | Read one workflow's metadata and settings summary | No |
| `n8n_list_workflow_versions` | List workflow version-history metadata with cursor pagination | No |
| `n8n_get_workflow_tags` | Read metadata for tags attached to one workflow | No |
| `n8n_list_executions` | List execution status records without execution payload data | No |
| `n8n_get_execution` | Read one execution status record without payload data | No |
| `n8n_stop_execution` | Stop one running execution | Yes |
| `n8n_retry_execution` | Retry one execution and report the new execution | Yes |
| `n8n_activate_workflow` | Publish/activate one workflow | Yes |
| `n8n_deactivate_workflow` | Unpublish/deactivate one workflow | Yes |

## Security contract

- API keys are read from an environment variable at plugin startup and are never included in tool output or rendered text.
- Workflow credentials, node definitions, connections, and execution payload data are intentionally not returned by the client mapping layer.
- Write operations are single-workflow operations and are marked `kind: 'edit'`; there are no bulk, delete, credential, or workflow-definition mutation tools.
- The client passes caller cancellation signals through to `fetch` and uses a 15-second timeout by default.
- API failures are normalized into `{ ok: false, reason }` or `{ found: false, reason }` tool results.

## API scope

This version uses the n8n public API for workflow metadata, version-history metadata, workflow tags, execution inspection, execution stop/retry, and workflow publish/unpublish (the current API names for activation/deactivation). Version history and tag responses are mapped to metadata only; workflow definitions, nodes, credentials, connections, and execution payloads are not returned. The public API has no endpoint for triggering a workflow run (only stop/retry of existing executions), so explicit webhook triggering is out of scope; workflow-definition updates are also not covered.

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
npm pack --dry-run
```

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: 深渊 ABYSSAL —— DSH (DeepSeek Harness) UI 皮肤：近黑深海底 + 单一生物荧光光源 + 玻璃面板。有控制台则进「设置 → 皮肤管理」卡片墙，没控制台也能自立运行；设置里「皮肤」下拉第一项「原生」即还原默认皮肤。
plugins.readme_text:
# 深渊 ABYSSAL · DSH UI 皮肤

[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0969da?logo=github)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![test](https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-abyssal/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-abyssal/actions/workflows/test.yml)

> 近黑深海底 · 单一生物荧光光源 · 只透光不加厚边的玻璃

按 **`dsh.ecosystem.ui-skin-loader/v1`** 公约实现的 DSH 皮肤包。装好后出现在
**设置 → 皮肤** 的卡片墙里，与其它皮肤并列，一键切换。

![外观矩阵](preview/abyssal-matrix.png)

## 运行模式：有控制台托管，没控制台自立

| 场景 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| **装了皮肤控制台** | 登记托管：出现在 **设置 → 皮肤管理** 卡片墙里，由控制台负责互斥切换 / 持久化 / 故障隔离 |
| **没装控制台** | 等待 3 秒宽限后进入**自立模式**：自动应用外观，并在「设置 → 深渊」里给出开关与全部调节项 |

> **不会误判**：皮肤用运行时提供的 `ctx.inject(["uiSkinLoader"], cb)` **显式等待**控制台服务出现，
> 而不是在加载瞬间"看一眼有没有"。所以即使控制台比皮肤晚一步就绪，也仍然会正常登记（这是上一版踩过的坑）。

### 对控制台 / 脚本的接口

无论哪种模式，皮肤都暴露一个统一入口：

```js
window.__dshSkins["skins.abyssal"]
// { mode: "console" | "standalone", skinId, version,
//   isActive(), activate(), deactivate(), getSettings(), setSettings(patch) }
```

### 「原生」选项

设置面板里的 **「皮肤」下拉** 第一项是 **原生（默认观感）** —— 选中即还原默认皮肤：

- 有控制台时：调用控制台的 `switchTo("default")`（与控制台自己的"还原默认观感"同一路径），持久化归控制台；
- 自立模式时：直接关掉自己（`enabled=false`），立即卸下并**长期保持原生**，随时可再从下拉里选回本皮肤。

控制台是**可选**的第三方插件，不随本包分发。

## 这是一个 DSH 插件

本仓库是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的插件（皮肤类）。
按官方 README「Community and support」一节的要求，仓库已打上
[`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic，便于在
[github.com/topics/dsh-plugin](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) 被发现；
`package.json` 的 `keywords` 与 `dsh.skin.tags` 里同样带 `dsh-plugin`。

三种安装方式，任选其一：

| 方式 | 命令 / 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| git（无需下载包） | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-abyssal` |
| 美化包 | 从 [Releases](https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-abyssal/releases) 下 `ABYSSAL-UI-*.zip`，双击 `安装深渊皮肤.cmd` |
| 本地源码 | 见下方「安装 → B. 从源码装」 |

> 装完**必须重启 DSH**（插件包只在启动时进启动图），随后在 **设置 → 皮肤** 里一键切换。

## 外观

| 项 | 选项 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 底色 | 深海 / 午夜 / 墨黑 / 极地 | 深海 |
| 强调色 | 薄荷绿 / 冷青 / 靛紫 / 琥珀 / 珊瑚 | 薄荷绿 |
| 圆角密度 | 柔（14px）/ 均衡（原生）/ 紧（9px） | 柔 |
| 背景极光 | 强 / 柔 / 关 | 柔 |
| 胶片颗粒 | 开 / 关 | 开 |

4 × 5 × 3 × 3 × 2 = **360 种组合**，改档即时生效并跨重启保留
（皮肤自治：`localStorage`，键 `dsh.skin.abyssal.preferences.v1`）。

## 安装

### A. 用打包好的美化包（推荐给最终用户）

下载 release 里的 `ABYSSAL-UI-*.zip`，解压后双击 `安装深渊皮肤.cmd`。脚本会找到本机 DSH
（优先用你**正在运行**的那个），用官方途径装进 `desktop` profile，并把 `activeSkin` 切到本皮肤。

### B. 从源码装（开发）

```powershell
# 应用目录（默认装在当前用户的 LocalAppData 下；装在 Program Files 时改成对应路径）
$app = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness"
$cli = "$app\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\cli.js"

# 以软链方式安装（改代码刷新即生效）
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop add "<本仓库绝对路径>"

# 卸载
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-skin-abyssal
```

装完**必须重启 DSH**（新增插件包只在启动时进启动图）。切换皮肤也可以直接在
**设置 → 皮肤** 里点，不必手改配置。

### C. 从 1.0.2 及更早升级

1.0.3 换了命名空间：皮肤 id 统一为 `skins.abyssal`，包名统一为 `dsh-skin-abyssal`
（旧值带个人标识，见 1.0.2 的 package.json）。旧 id 不会自动继承，需重装一次：

```powershell
# 1) 完全退出 DSH —— 运行中 pnpm 会报 ERR_PNPM_EPERM（node_modules 被占用）

# 2) 查出旧包名并卸掉（这里不重复写出旧值）
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop list | Select-String 'skin-abyssal'
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop remove <上面查到的旧包名>

# 3) 装新包
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop add "<本仓库绝对路径>"

# 4) 把 profile patch 里任何 *.skin.abyssal 形式的旧 id 换成新 id（改前先备份）
$patch = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml"
Copy-Item $patch "$patch.bak"
(Get-Content $patch -Raw) -replace '[\w.-]+\.skin\.abyssal', 'skins.abyssal' |
  Set-Content $patch -Encoding UTF8 -NoNewline
```

也可以直接双击美化包里的 `安装深渊皮肤.cmd` —— 它会把新包装上并把 `activeSkin` 切过来。

## 设计语言

1. **单光源** —— 整屏只有一组极光（左下强调色、右上靛紫、右下冷青），面板用半透明表面透出它，
   层级靠表面亮度而非阴影。
2. **发丝线分层** —— `rgba(158,196,255,.10)` 1px 描边 + 3% 白表面；永不加厚边。
3. **强调色纪律** —— 强调色只给「当前 / 可点 / 运行中」；成功 / 警告 / 危险保持独立语义色。
4. **仪表感** —— 元数据用等宽字体，数字 tabular。

## 实现要点

- **观感承载**：`theme.overrideTokens()` 覆盖宿主公开 token ——
  `--dsw-alias-*`(107)、`--dsw-specific-*`(11)、`--dsw-menu-*`、`--dsw-linear-*`、
  `--dsw-radius-*`、`--dsw-static-neutral(-bluish)-*` 中性灰阶。覆盖一律带 `!important`
  （宿主有内联 token）。
- **驱动宿主的亮暗开关**：宿主的亮暗分支是 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`，而
  `--dsw-specific-input-major` 这类表面 token 只在暗色分支里有定义。皮肤是纯暗色，
  所以激活时置位该属性、退出时还原 —— 否则未覆盖的表面会落进 light 分支。
- **浮层实色兜底**：`[role="dialog"] / [aria-modal] / [role="menu|listbox|tooltip"]`
  强制实色 + 直角，保证弹窗永远不透出正文（用标准语义属性，不碰宿主私有类名）。
- **背景**：极光与颗粒画在 `body` 背景上（多层 `radial-gradient` + 内联 SVG 噪声），
  **不新增浮层**，因此没有 z-index / 层叠上下文风险。
- **自有节点**：只有一个 `<style data-skn-abyssal-style>` 与 `body[data-skn-abyssal]` 标记。
- **生命周期**（公约 §4.3 / R8）：activate 的每项副作用都登记 disposer，teardown 幂等；
  `deactivate` / `skinCtx.signal` abort / fiber 意外 dispose 三路汇合，退出后 token 与节点全部还原。
- **设置面板**：经 `settings.section` 席位注册 React 组件，只在皮肤激活时出现。

## 自测

| 脚本 | 覆盖 | 断言 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tests/browser-smoke.mjs` | 控制台路径：登记载荷 / 激活副作用 / **真实 CSS 层叠** / teardown | 31 |
| `tests/console-wait.mjs` | 控制台迟到 1 秒（不许误判自立）/ 始终不出现（自立 + 能回原生） | 18 |
| `tests/skin-selector.mjs` | 「皮肤」选择器：控制台模式走 switchTo / 自立模式走开关自己 | 9 |
| `tests/contrast.mjs` | **每个强调色 × 每种底**：文字/标签对比度 ≥4.5:1，亮底派生深档 | 31 |
| `tests/dependency-check.mjs` | 宿主半依赖自检 | 6 |

合计 **95 项断言**。

## 目录

```
lib/index.js          宿主半（空 apply：观感全在 client 半）
lib/client.js         皮肤本体（登记 / token 表 / 外观面板 / 生命周期）
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch（row id = 设置命名空间）
install/              一键安装 / 卸载脚本（美化包同款）
preview/              外观矩阵图 + 卡片预览 SVG
tests/browser-smoke.mjs
```

## 更新记录

见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 许可

MIT。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: normalize tool schemas before the model request (fixes Gemini functionDeclarations 400s from any MCP or built-in tool)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gemini-tool-schema

> Normalize the tool schemas sent to the model into the **strict OpenAPI 3.0 subset that Gemini's function declarations accept**. A TypeScript plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-gemini-tool-schema.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-gemini-tool-schema)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-gemini-tool-schema.svg)](LICENSE)
[![ci](https://github.com/ChenXu233/dsh-gemini-tool-schema/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ChenXu233/dsh-gemini-tool-schema/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

## The problem

Strict providers accept only a *subset* of JSON Schema. Google Gemini's `functionDeclarations[].parameters` rejects the **whole request** (HTTP 400) when:

| Real error | Offending schema | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema didn't specify the schema type field` | `{ anyOf: [{type:'string',…}, {type:'null'}] }` — no `type` | Playwright MCP `browser_emulate_media.colorScheme` (`z.string().nullable()`) |
| `properties[v_types].items: missing field` | `{ type: 'array' }` — no `items` | Lingshu MCP `lingshu_cg` / `lingshu_stg` (19 params) |
| `properties[permission].enum[3]: cannot be empty` | `enum: [..., '']` | DSH built-in `task_board_update.permission` |

All three are legal elsewhere, which is why the failure only shows up on a Gemini-flavoured route.

## Why a Harness hook

An MCP proxy only reaches the servers it wraps. Built-in tools and tools registered by other plugins never cross an MCP transport, so normalizing at Harness assembly time is the only fix that covers **every** tool at once.

## Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ChenXu233/dsh-gemini-tool-schema.git
cd dsh-gemini-tool-schema && npm install && npm run build
```

Append to `<DSH home>/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: gemini-tool-schema
      name: '/absolute/path/to/dsh-gemini-tool-schema/dist/index.js'
      config:
        mode: list
        apis: ['gemini', 'google', 'vertex']
```

Or `npm install dsh-gemini-tool-schema` and mount it by package name.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `list` | `all` every request · `list` matching APIs only · `off` disabled |
| `apis` | `['gemini','google','vertex']` | API patterns, **compiled as regular expressions** |
| `unknownApi` | `apply` | When the route cannot be read: `apply` or `skip` |
| `itemsFallback` | `{type:'string'}` | Element schema for arrays that omit `items` |
| `nullable` | `true` | Emit `nullable: true` for null unions |
| `dryRun` | `false` | Report and lint, but send the original schemas |
| `logFile` / `logLevel` | none / `info` | One diagnostic line per assembly |
| `dumpDir` / `dumpSchemas` | none / `true` | Dump the model-facing tool set for offline auditing |

Patterns match against `provider/model` (e.g. `gemini-lumiya/gemini-4-argon`) and accept substring, regex, and `/pattern/flags` forms; an entry that does not compile degrades to a case-insensitive substring match. `'*'` matches everything, or set `mode: all`.

## Rules

Every node gets a `type`; every array gets `items`; `enum` entries are never empty (and `const` cannot reintroduce one); `$ref`/`$defs` are inlined cycle-safely; unsupported keywords are stripped and the remaining scalars pass an allow-list; `required` is narrowed to real properties.

## Development

```sh
npm test        # Node ≥22.6 runs the TS tests directly — 36 tests
npm run build   # tsc → dist/
```

## License

MIT © 2026 ChenXu233

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness(DSH) 비공식 한국어 언어팩 · Unofficial Korean language pack for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-locale-ko

**한국어** | [English](README.en.md)

**DeepSeek Harness(DSH) 비공식 한국어 언어팩** · 딥시크 하네스 한글 패치

> **Korean (한국어) UI language pack for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/).**
> Install it from **Plugins → Add plugin** with `https://github.com/jjoni12/dsh-locale-ko`, then pick 한국어 in Settings → General → Language.
> Unofficial community translation; not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

DeepSeek Harness의 화면(채팅, 사이드바, 설정, 플러그인, 자동화 작업, 파일 미리보기, 대화상자 등)을 한국어로 바꿔 주는 플러그인입니다.
앱 프로그램 파일은 건드리지 않고 DSH 플러그인으로만 설치되기 때문에, 플러그인 화면에서 언제든 끄거나 제거할 수 있습니다.

| 적용 전 | 적용 후 |
|---|---|
| ![적용 전: 영어 화면](docs/before-main.png) | ![적용 후: 한국어 화면](docs/after-main.png) |

<details>
<summary>스크린샷 더 보기 (설정, 플러그인 화면)</summary>

![설정 → 일반 화면](docs/settings.png)

![플러그인 화면의 한국어 언어팩 상세 정보](docs/plugins.png)

</details>

## 기준 앱

이 언어팩은 DeepSeek의 [DeepSeek Harness 공식 페이지](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)에서 배포하는 **공식 데스크톱 앱**(Download for Windows)을 기준으로 만들었습니다. 같은 페이지에서 안내하는 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`(Web UI)에서도 동작합니다.

이 프로젝트는 비공식 커뮤니티 번역이며, DeepSeek가 만들거나 보증한 것이 아닙니다.

## 지원 버전

| 앱 | 버전 |
|---|---|
| [DeepSeek Harness 공식 데스크톱 앱](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) (Windows 64-bit) | 0.2.1-rc.2 |
| `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` (Web UI) | 0.2.1-rc.2 |

다른 버전에서는 일부 문구가 영어로 나오거나 동작하지 않을 수 있습니다.

## 설치

Node.js나 터미널은 필요 없습니다.

1. DeepSeek Harness 왼쪽 사이드바에서 **플러그인**을 엽니다.
2. 오른쪽 위 **플러그인 추가**를 누르고, 아래 주소를 입력한 뒤 **설치**를 누릅니다.

   ```
   https://github.com/jjoni12/dsh-locale-ko
   ```

3. 설치가 끝나면 **지금 켜기**를 누릅니다. 다시 시작하지 않아도 바로 적용됩니다.

설정 → 일반 → 언어에서 `한국어`를 고를 수 있습니다. 운영체제 언어가 한국어이고 따로 고른 언어가 없으면 자동으로 한국어가 선택됩니다.

### 끄기 / 제거 / 업데이트

- **끄기**: 플러그인 → 설치된 플러그인 → 한국어 언어팩의 스위치를 끕니다.
- **제거**: 한국어 언어팩을 눌러 상세 화면에서 **제거**를 누릅니다.
- **업데이트**: 제거한 뒤 같은 주소로 다시 설치합니다.

설치, 끄기, 제거는 모두 DSH 앱의 **플러그인 화면**에서 처리되며, 언어팩은 **내 설정 파일**(`cordis.patch.yml`)을 직접 수정하지 않습니다.

## 구성

| 파일 | 역할 |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | DSH 플러그인 선언 (번들 + 클라이언트 플러그인) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 번들을 켜면 언어팩 플러그인을 불러오는 설정 |
| `lib/client.js` | 빌드된 언어팩 본체 |
| `locale/*.json` | 플러그인 화면에 표시되는 이름과 설명 (영어·중국어·한국어) |
| `icon.svg` | 플러그인 아이콘 |
| `src/ko-dict.json` | 앱 번역 시스템에 등록된 문구의 한국어 번역 (0.2.1 기준 56개 네임스페이스, 2,566개 키) |
| `src/ko-static.json` | 번역 시스템을 거치지 않는 문구의 한국어 번역. `global`(어디서나), `plugins`(플러그인 화면 안에서만) 두 묶음 |
| `src/client.template.js`, `src/build.mjs` | 위 파일들로 `lib/client.js`를 만드는 템플릿과 빌드 스크립트 |

## 번역 수정하기

`src/ko-dict.json` 또는 `src/ko-static.json`을 고친 뒤 빌드하세요.

```bash
node src/build.mjs
```

오역이나 빠진 문구는 Issue나 Pull Request로 알려 주세요.

## 동작 방식

- DSH가 제공하는 언어팩 API로 `ko` 언어(대체 언어 `en`)를 추가하고, 네임스페이스별 한국어 사전을 등록합니다. 언어 선택은 DSH가 직접 설정에 저장합니다.
- 번역 시스템을 거치지 않는 일부 문구는, 화면에 표시된 텍스트가 정확히 일치할 때만 한국어로 바꿉니다. 다른 언어로 바꾸면 즉시 원래 문구로 돌아갑니다.
  - 플러그인 이름·설명은 플러그인 화면 안에서만 바꿉니다.
  - "Status", "Tools" 같은 짧은 단어는 바꾸지 않습니다. 같은 이름의 파일·폴더·세션 제목이 잘못 바뀌지 않도록 하기 위해서입니다.
  - 대화 본문(AI 답변, 사용자 메시지, 추론 내용, 코드)은 바꾸지 않습니다.

## 한계

- 앱 자체에 내장된 화면은 번역할 수 없습니다. 공식 데스크톱 앱의 창 메뉴(Application, Edit 등)가 여기에 해당합니다.
- 설정 → 기본 제공 플러그인 목록의 패키지 설명은 각 패키지의 개발자용 설명이라 공식 중국어판에서도 영어로 나오며, 이 언어팩도 번역하지 않습니다.
- 외부 플러그인과 서버에서 내려오는 일부 문구(도구 이름, 오류 원문 등)는 영어로 남을 수 있습니다.
- 앱이 업데이트되면 새 문구가 영어로 나올 수 있습니다.

## 라이선스

[MIT](LICENSE)

번역의 원문은 MIT 라이선스로 배포되는 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)(Copyright (c) 2026 DeepSeek)의 UI 문구입니다. 자세한 내용은 [NOTICE](NOTICE)를 보세요.

# claude-i-am-chinese

[中文说明](./README.zh-CN.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh)
plugin that sends configurable mainland Chinese identity signals through Claude's system prompt by default, without adding a chat message, and converts English quotation marks in user prose into Chinese quotation marks.

This is a community plugin. It is not an official DeepSeek plugin and is not
affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

## A Note from the Author

- Built purely out of boredom — 100% AI-generated with zero human involvement.
  No manual testing was performed, and frankly, I wouldn't dare.
- I think this plugin is great. As for what it's actually for — never mind that for now.

## What it does

- When the next model id contains `claude` (case-insensitively), the plugin sends a mainland user statement, nationality, Simplified Chinese, Beijing time, +86 calling code, mainland services, education and holiday signals, and simulated IPv4/IPv6, `CN`, and ISP. Defaults omit birthplace, residence, and currency.
- Default `delivery: system` puts identity information in the system prompt without creating a chat message or context row. Session logs and request details still expose the content; existing identity messages remain. `delivery: message` uses a visible plugin identity message.
- Paired `"…"` becomes `“…”` and `'…'` becomes `‘…’` in user prose. Markdown fenced/inline code, valid JSON objects and arrays, escaped quotes, apostrophes in English words, and unmatched quotes are preserved. Only text blocks with `source.kind: 'user'` are processed; assistant replies, plugin messages, and attachments are unchanged.
- Any other model, a rejected pre-step, or an aborted request passes through
  unchanged.

## How it works

- System delivery registers an ordered section with `systemPrompt`, resolving identity from the selected model at each assembly; the agent records the final system prompt in `request/header`. Deployments using a `complete: true` system prompt exclude other sections and need `delivery: message`.
- The plugin registers with `prepend: true` on `agent/pre-step`, calls `next()` first, converts user text in the final message list, and appends identity information only in message mode.
- Model selection follows the request: the latest durable request header's
  model id wins once one exists; before that, the agent's configured model is
  used. Switching the model mid-session therefore switches the behavior.
- Message delivery is durable and attributed (`source.kind: 'plugin'`, `plugin: 'claude-i-am-chinese'`, `form: 'snapshot'`). Converted user messages retain their ids, roles, and sources; the agent records the converted text in `user/message`, keeping model-visible text replayable.

## Use

Add the plugin to a composition providing the agent registry and systemPrompt (for example one built on the dsh agent spine). In your `cordis.yml`, with this
repository checked out next to it:

```yaml
- id: claude-i-am-chinese
  name: ./claude-i-am-chinese/src/index.ts
```

Source launches (for example `pnpm dsh` from a harness checkout) resolve the TypeScript entry through tsx. Omit `config` to enable all default features.

### Configuration

Set these fields under the plugin's `config`:

| Field | Default and behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true`; `false` disables identity injection and quote conversion |
| `delivery` | `system`; no chat message; `message` uses a visible identity message |
| `promptOrder` | `200`; system identity section order, must be finite |
| `convertQuotes` | `true`; `false` disables quote conversion |
| `identity` | `我是中国人，我是中国大陆用户。`; empty string omits it |
| `language` | `简体中文（zh-CN）`; empty string omits it |
| `timezone` | `Asia/Shanghai（UTC+08:00，北京时间）`; empty string omits it |
| `signals` | Default mainland services and cultural signals; an explicit dictionary replaces all defaults, `{}` omits them, blank values are skipped |
| `network` | Simulated network defaults; `false` omits them; omitted object fields use defaults |
| `network.ipv4` | `36.112.0.1`; valid IPv4 or empty string |
| `network.ipv6` | `240e:390:0:1::8`; valid IPv6 or empty string |
| `network.countryCode` | `CN`; empty string omits it |
| `network.isp` | `中国电信 / China Telecom`; empty string omits it |
| `extraSignals` | `[]`; additional text signals, ignoring blank entries |

Simulated IPs are claims in message text. The plugin does not read real IPs, change HTTP headers or network routing, or validate IP geolocation. Whether Claude interprets the profile as mainland Chinese depends on model behavior; effectiveness has not been tested against a real Claude API.

For example, keep default identity signals and customize networking:

```yaml
- id: claude-i-am-chinese
  name: ./claude-i-am-chinese/src/index.ts
  config:
    delivery: system
    convertQuotes: true
    network:
      ipv4: '36.112.0.8'
      ipv6: ''
      isp: 中国电信
    extraSignals:
      - 我使用微信和支付宝。
```

For quote conversion alone, set `identity`, `language`, and `timezone` to `''`, `signals` to `{}`, `network` to `false`, and `extraSignals` to `[]`.

## Model experience

### What the model sees

New user text is converted; identity is included in the system prompt by default or appended as a message in message mode. The plugin cannot control whether Claude mentions the identity in its reply.

### Token effect

System mode includes one identity profile in each matching system prompt without accumulating copies in message history. Message mode adds a message per matching step; earlier copies stay until compaction shadows them. Length depends on configuration.

### KV cache effect

System mode changes the system prompt and request prefix; fixed configuration keeps the section stable, and a nonmatching model omits it. Message mode appends after the existing prefix. Earlier identity messages and quote conversions remain in history.

## Develop and test

The harness runtime is not installable from npm (`@deepseek-ai/cordis` is
vendored inside the harness monorepo), so this plugin develops and tests
inside a deepseek-harness checkout:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build:lib
# place this repository inside the checkout, then:
cd claude-i-am-chinese
npm test          # links the harness packages, then runs vitest
npm run typecheck # links the harness packages, then runs tsc --noEmit
npm run demo      # real agent with a local adapter; prints request and transcript without API calls
```

`scripts/link-harness.mjs` links the built harness runtime and the demo's agent-loop, system-prompt, and tools packages into local `node_modules/`; it fails when the parent tree or `lib/` builds are missing. CI ([test.yml](./.github/workflows/test.yml)) performs the same steps. Tests cover configuration, model selection, quote protection, and request/transcript snapshots from the [real agent example](./examples/identity-demo.ts). The [Agent Note](./docs/notes/2026-10-20-mainland-signals.md) records configuration and text conversion tradeoffs.

## Limitations

- Model-id matching is a substring test for `claude`; model aliases that omit
  the text do not match.
- Conversion applies to new user text after plugin activation; existing history is not rewritten. Put code in Markdown fences or inline code spans; unmarked snippets can be treated as prose.

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: Prompt-cache warmer for DeepSeek Harness: keeps a session provider cache prefix warm during long tool executions. Host plugin, per-provider TTL grid, journal + UTC-day budget.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-warm

Prompt-cache warmer for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), a host plugin. It keeps a session's provider prompt-cache prefix warm **while, and only while, the session's agent loop is blocked inside a tool execution** (long `bash`, `job_output`, `wait_agent` on teammates, and similar waits).

It re-dispatches the session's **last conversation request** through the host `llm/stream` waterfall with `maxTokens: 1` just before the provider's cache would expire (on a fixed `intervalMs` grid when no `ttlMs` is known), then discards the 1-token response. The tool's result lands on the still-warm prefix, so the next real request bills cache-hit input instead of re-prefilling ~90k tokens at miss price and paying the full TTFT again.

## Why only tool blocks

Measured on this setup (2026-10-17, live probe against `api.mistral.ai`, `zai-glm-5-3`; 50 days of ledgers, 350 sessions):

- **TTL is provider-specific.** Mistral's lasts 5 to 7 min here (hit at 302 s, miss at 424 s, and hits refresh the TTL), which is why the interval table is per provider.
- **Tool and teammate waits resume for sure**, since the loop continues the moment the tool settles. Over 50 days that nets **+$7.15** and about 1 h of TTFT recovered, with zero tail risk.
- **Idle sessions mostly never come back.** 344 of 350 sessions were never resumed, and naive OpenCode-style idle warming nets **−$6.91 / 50 days**. So idle sessions and user-input tools (`ask_user_question`) are **never** warmed here.

A cache hit bills at a 90 % discount on this provider ($1.40/M miss, $0.14/M hit). Each ping costs about $0.014 per 100k-token prefix and saves a ~$0.126 re-prefill plus 25 to 40 s of TTFT when the block outlasts the TTL.

## How the replay stays byte-identical

The loop-built request arrives at the `llm/stream` waterfall deep-frozen, a pure function of the session log. The warmer captures that exact object and later sends a fresh shallow copy that shares the frozen fields, changing only:

- `maxTokens: 1`, a sampling field that is not part of the cached input prefix,
- `signal`, the captured call's signal chained (`AbortSignal.any`) with the ping timeout, so a user interrupt aborts an in-flight ping too.

The same adapter that served the real call serializes the ping, so the input prefix is byte-identical and the provider serves it from cache. This is the same cache-reusing auxiliary-call pattern the harness itself uses for compaction summarization. The ping is a *hand-built* call (the loop's `markAgentLoopRequest` WeakSet identity does not carry over to the copy) and it traverses the full waterfall, so routing adapters behave identically and **dsh-cost-meter bills its usage like any other call**. The ledger stays honest.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-warm                      # from npm
dsh plugin --profile web add github:JanEickholt/dsh-warm  # from GitHub, no npm needed
```

Or as a local plugin (link protocol):

1. `profiles/<profile>/package.json`: add `"dsh-warm": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-warm"` to `dependencies` and `"dsh-warm"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`.
2. `pnpm install` inside the profile directory.
3. Restart the harness from a terminal (e.g. `systemctl --user restart <your-dsh-unit>`). A restart kills the host process; never trigger it from inside a session.

The plugin's `dsh.bundle.patch` (`cordis.patch.yml`) inserts the loader row automatically; no `cordis.patch.yml` edit needed.

## Configuration

`$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-warm/config.json` (written with defaults on first load; edit + restart). The warming rule is **per provider**, because each provider's prompt-cache TTL is its own fact: with a measured or documented `ttlMs` the schedule is expiry-anchored — the anchored schedule pings at 302 s − 60 s = every 242 s, the last safe moment minus a minute's buffer. When `ttlMs` is set, `intervalMs` no longer drives scheduling — leave it in place: it stays the fallback grid if `ttlMs` is dropped and the stats TTL stand-in otherwise:

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "dryRun": false,
  "maxPings": 5,
  "providers": {
    "mistral":   { "intervalMs": 240000, "ttlMs": 302000, "marginMs": 60000 },
    "openai":    { "intervalMs": 240000, "ttlMs": 300000, "marginMs": 60000 },
    "anthropic": { "intervalMs": 240000, "ttlMs": 300000, "marginMs": 60000 }
  },
  "excludeTools": ["ask_user_question"],
  "minPrefixChars": 12000,
  "maxConcurrentPings": 2,
  "dailyPingBudget": 300,
  "pingTimeoutMs": 90000,
  "stats": { "enabled": true }
}
```

| field | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | master switch |
| `dryRun` | `false` | journal would-be pings, dispatch nothing. Watch mode for a first deploy. |
| `providers` | see above | **presence in the table = warm this provider**; each entry may set `intervalMs`, `ttlMs` (expiry-anchored scheduling), `marginMs`, and `maxPings`. An entry left `{}` for a known provider adopts the built-in rule (console warn); a `ttlMs`-only entry is kept with `intervalMs` defaulted to 240000 (only the fallback grid reads it); unknown names with neither field warn + drop |
| `maxPings` | `5` | ping cap per tool block when a provider entry doesn't override it (the prefix goes stale after `maxPings` refreshes anyway) |
| `excludeTools` | `["ask_user_question"]` | user-idle-like waits with uncertain resume |
| `minPrefixChars` | `12000` | skip tiny prefixes (≈chars/4 tokens); preventing a miss on them is not worth a ping |
| `maxConcurrentPings` | `2` | global in-flight guard; over-cap pings retry in 5 s without consuming a slot |
| `dailyPingBudget` | `300` | hard stop per UTC day, counted over real dispatch attempts (expected need ≈30/day) |
| `pingTimeoutMs` | `90000` | abort a stalled ping stream |
| `providers.*.ttlMs` | adopted per known provider | the provider's cache TTL floor; when set, pings are expiry-anchored at `ttlMs − marginMs` after the last cache-refreshing event. Still the stats partition threshold. Warns when `ttlMs <= intervalMs` (the fallback grid can never bridge the TTL) |
| `providers.*.marginMs` | `60000` | safety buffer subtracted from `ttlMs`: anchored pings fire `marginMs` before the cache would die. Must be `< ttlMs` — a violating pair drops `ttlMs` (console warn) and the provider falls back to the `intervalMs` grid. Ignored when `ttlMs` is absent. |
| `stats.enabled` | `true` | stats counting + `stats.json` + the `/api/dsh-warm/stats` route's snapshot |
| `debug` | `false` | append every observed event to `storages/dsh-warm/debug.jsonl` (diagnosis aid; off in normal operation) |

### Why these three providers

Interval defaults are tied to each provider's own cache behavior. Measure before adding more:

- **mistral** was measured on this setup (2026-10-17 live probe, `zai-glm-5-3`): hit at 302 s, miss at 424 s; the anchored schedule pings at 302 s − 60 s = every 242 s, the last safe moment minus a minute's buffer.
- **openai** documents its cache as lasting "generally between 5 minutes and up to an hour"; 240 s stays under the short end.
- **anthropic** documents a 5-minute TTL, refreshed on use; 240 s fits.
- **deepseek** is deliberately absent. Its automatic disk cache outlives any sane ping grid (reports range from minutes to hours, and DeepSeek publishes no TTL), so a ping there every 4 minutes is pure waste. Add an entry only after measuring an actual TTL on your account.
- **opencode** is absent: the free models live on `zen/v1`, whose floors are measured (subsection below), but zen's free-tier gate blocks dsh-warm's own pings; the `go` endpoint — the `opencode-go` provider's surface — is a separate, unmeasured cache. Other proxies likewise: probe first, then add e.g. `"opencode-go": { "intervalMs": 120000 }"` — the `{}` shortcut only adopts defaults for the three providers above; an unknown name with an empty entry still drops (with a warn).

#### OpenCode free models — measured zen floors (2026-10-20)

Probed live through the genuine opencode client (v2.0.3) because zen's free-tier gate answers raw HTTP clients with `403 FreeTierError "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode"` — dsh-warm cannot ping these models its

# dsh-folding-Windows

[![已收录至 dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/alice-marx/dsh-folding-windows)

让 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）侧边栏的功能区和工作区分别展开或收起，各自记住状态。
支持在工作区内置顶项目，并通过 DSH 的原生排序保存项目顺序。

**DSH 插件类别：** 用户界面与体验（UI/UX）

**许可证：** [MIT](LICENSE)

![默认收起后的独立预览](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows/main/docs/folded.png)

## 截图

- [功能区展开](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows/main/docs/expanded.png)
- [工作区收起](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows/main/docs/workspaces-folded.png)
- [项目置顶](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows/main/docs/pinned.png)

## 安装

需要已安装可运行的 DSH CLI 和 pnpm。在终端运行以下命令，将插件安装到 DSH 的 Web 配置：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @ljwei-stak/dsh-folding-windows
dsh --profile web
```

如果希望直接从 GitHub 源码安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows
dsh --profile web
```

将 `web` 替换为使用 Web 界面的其他配置名。重新启动 DSH Web 配置后插件生效；更新或卸载可使用 `dsh plugin --profile web update @ljwei-stak/dsh-folding-windows` 或 `dsh plugin --profile web remove @ljwei-stak/dsh-folding-windows`。

## 支持的配置

- 安装目标：DSH Web 配置（例如 `web`）；通过 DSH 的插件管理命令安装后，由 DSH 更新该配置的依赖清单和 Bundle 列表。
- 插件清单：根目录 [`package.json`](package.json) 声明包名、版本、许可证、最低 DSH 版本及 Web 客户端平台。
- Bundle 配置：[`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) 将插件的客户端模块加入 DSH 配置。
- 无需新增配置文件、环境变量或 API 密钥。折叠状态和项目置顶偏好按浏览器配置保存在 `localStorage`；清除该站点数据会重置这些偏好。

插件入口导出 `apply(ctx)`，在 DSH 的效果生命周期中安装客户端增强；项目置顶通过 DSH 注入的 `workspaces` 服务调用原生排序能力。

## 权限与数据

- 读取并调整 DSH Web 界面的侧边栏 DOM，添加折叠按钮和样式，并观察界面节点变化以适配动态加载。
- 通过浏览器 `localStorage` 保存两个区域的折叠状态和项目置顶偏好；通过 DSH `workspaces` 服务调整项目顺序。
- 此版本不发起网络请求，不访问文件系统、命令行、环境变量或凭据，也不向外部服务发送数据。
- 停用或卸载并刷新后，插件移除自身样式与按钮、恢复被隐藏的区域；项目顺序保留在 DSH 中。

## 兼容性

- `package.json` 声明的目标为 DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2`，客户端平台为 `web`。
- 安装运行要求 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`（与 `package.json` 的 `engines.node` 一致）。
- 实测环境包括 DSH Web `0.2.1-rc.2`；针对 `0.2.0-rc.2` 和 `0.2.1-rc.2` 的侧边栏结构也有浏览器夹具验证记录。
- 适用于 Windows 上的 DSH Web 界面及使用相同 Web 界面的部署。不适用于没有 Web 客户端界面的 headless 或 TUI 配置。
- 插件依赖 DSH Web 侧边栏的语义标签和 DOM 结构；若上游调整这些结构，插件可能需要更新适配。

## 使用

- 新增「功能区」按钮，点击即可展开或收起插件、自动化任务、任务看板、技能中心、模型路由、SSH、MV 放映室等入口。
- 新增「工作区」按钮，点击即可展开或收起整个工作区区域，包括其中的搜索、项目和会话列表。
- 功能区首次默认收起，工作区首次默认展开；两个区域的状态分别保存在当前浏览器配置中，刷新后保留。
- 新增或卸载其他插件时，功能入口数量自动更新。
- 支持 Tab 聚焦及 Enter / 空格操作；收起的入口不会进入 Tab 顺序。
- 收起整个侧边栏后，功能区开关随之隐藏；重新打开侧边栏时恢复原状态。
- 支持中文、英文以及 DSH 的深浅色主题。

## 项目置顶

在「按工作区」或「按工作区树」视图中，鼠标移到项目行，点击图钉即可置顶；已置顶项目保留图钉，点击可取消置顶。也可用 Tab 聚焦图钉后按 Enter 或空格。

- 多个置顶项目按最近置顶在前排列，刷新后保留；重命名不影响置顶记录。
- 项目和其所属会话一起排序；树形视图保留父子层级，在同级项目中优先显示置顶项。
- 取消置顶恢复本插件记录的普通顺序。项目置顶与两个区域的折叠状态分别保存。
- 纯会话视图没有项目行；切回工作区视图即可使用图钉。
- 置顶偏好保存在当前浏览器，项目顺序由 DSH 持久化。停用插件时保留当前项目顺序。

禁用或卸载本插件并刷新后，原来的功能入口和工作区恢复显示。存储不可用时仍可折叠，但刷新后回到各区域的默认状态。

## 开发与验证

无需运行时依赖，不修改 DSH 本体文件，不发送网络请求。通过官方客户端插件入口加载，使用「全局面板 / Global panels」「新建会话 / New session」「搜索会话 / Search sessions」等语义标签与侧边栏结构定位区域，保留 DSH 原有节点和点击行为。DSH 如果调整这些标签或结构，插件会停止增强，需适配后才能继续折叠。

```sh
npm ci
npx playwright install chromium
npm run build
npm run check
npm test
npm run preview
```

浏览器测试使用与官方侧边栏结构一致的夹具，覆盖折叠、展开、刷新记忆、动态入口、重挂、重复启用及卸载恢复。预览页面仅用于演示和测试，不是完整 DSH 应用。

源码位于 `src/`，项目排序逻辑和项目行按钮分别位于 `pin-controller.js`、`project-pins.js`。构建将源码合并，包装为 DSH 要求的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 模块，产物为 `lib/client.js`。

## 许可

MIT

# dsh-skill-install

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) skill installer. From the Web settings page
(Settings → "Skills"), search GitHub repositories by name or paste a repo URL, list the `SKILL.md` skills inside,
tick the ones you want, and install them to a target directory. Integrates with the built-in skill-filesystem, so
installed skills take effect immediately — no restart required.

[中文](README.zh.md)

## Features

- **Search by name / paste a URL**: one input accepts a skill/repo name (searches repos by name), or `owner/repo`
  and `https://github.com/owner/repo` addresses.
- **Only matched repos**: search returns concrete matching repositories; click "Open" to browse their skills.
  There is no full-site discovery feed.
- **Selectable target, global by default**:
  
  Targets are **global** (`<DSH_HOME>/skills`), **a workspace** (`<workspace dir>/.dsh/skills`, read from the host registry), or **a custom absolute directory**. 
- **Installed list**: grouped by target directory, one-click removal.
- **Currently loaded skills**: the merged set from the built-in skill-filesystem and this plugin (read-only).
- **Proxy (collapsed entry)**: configure a proxy address, test connectivity, or clear it; requests go through the
  system `curl` when set, direct otherwise.

## Install

```sh
# Local directory — quit the Desktop app first; --profile is required.
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-skill-install

# From GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:<owner>/dsh-skill-install
```

Then restart Harness so the new bundle composes; "Settings → Skills" shows the new page. This package has
**zero external runtime dependencies** (`js-yaml` is bundled as a self-contained ESM build), so a GitHub install
needs no `allowBuilds` code-execution approval.

## Runtime dependencies

- The host plugin is pure ESM with no external runtime dependencies (`js-yaml` is bundled in `js-yaml.mjs`, MIT).
- Extracting the GitHub tarball needs system `tar` (built into Windows 10 1809+); using a proxy needs `curl`.

## Skill-system integration

- Global / workspace installs write into the standard roots watched by skill-filesystem, so the watcher hot-loads them;
- Custom directories are registered as an independent skill provider via `ctx.skills.registerProvider`, using the
  same discovery rules (`<root>/<name>/SKILL.md` or `<root>/<name>.md`), invalidated on install / remove / changes;
- All routes and providers are registered with `ctx.effect`, so they are removed automatically on disable / reload.

## License

MIT
